in_marathi.name: Rajdip
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajdip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raj means 'king' and dip means 'sun'. The name Rajdip signifies that the person is a leader or a ruler who is as radiant and powerful as the Sun.
